source_definition: The source gives a rational symmetric matrix R with diagonal one. Its outputs are rational convex mixtures of sign vectors s∈{−1,+1}ⁿ realizing R as the weighted sum of ssᵀ, or NO-SOLUTION.
target_definition: The target is a fully symmetric rational order-four tensor T of variable dimension with T[i,i,i,i]=T[i,i,j,j]=1 for every i,j. Ask for a representation as a sum of real fourth tensor powers, with no term-count bound. On this normalized domain the output encoding is a rational convex mixture of fourth powers of sign vectors, or NO-SOLUTION; equivalence of that certificate convention to real decomposability is part of the theorem.
required_result: Construct deterministic polynomial-time maps F and G: F sends every legal source instance to a legal target instance, and G(x,y) is a valid source output for every valid output y of F(x). Preserve the stated threshold, domain and promises. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
